test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 04 May 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Fill in the blank with appropriate word.**

His place was __________ in the team after he displayed his explosive batting style.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 4'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** blank requires** a verb that indicates securing or affirming one's position.
 
• **"Cemented"** is the correct word, meaning to make something more certain or secure.
 
• **It aligns well** with the context of the sentence, describing how the individual secured his place on the team.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *"His place was cemented in the team after he displayed his explosive batting style." *

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1: **"Fermented" **means to undergo fermentation; it does not fit the context of the sentence.
 
• Option 2:** "Affected"** means influenced or changed, which is not suitable in this context.
 
• Option 3:** "Belittled"** means to make someone or something seem unimportant, which is the opposite of the intended meaning.
